title: Great Hop on Hop off experience
text: This was one of the better hop on hop off experiences we have had globally. Definitely worth getting the 48hr ticket!!!
author: 72antonym

title: Great way to take in a lot of Barcelona in a day
text:
A really good way to take in a lot of Barcelona, in our case during a 3 night stay, to experience parts that you might not have been aware of. It could be a good thing to do at the start of a stay, to see locations that you then decide to visit later during your visit. 
We hopped off 2 to 3 times, including the Olympic park where we took the cable car ride for great views of the city, and a hop off to chill at a beach. Plenty of stop off points to choose from, and we were always able to get seats on the top deck. All the staff were friendly and helpful.
author: A3200SCmarka

title: Open bus tour
text: Great way to see Barcelona and guided information.

title: Worth seeing and easy
text: Hop on Hop off works without any problems ‚ all important sights are served Lines can be changed
author: Adventure575321

title: View of Beautiful Barcelona
text: This hop on and hop off tour is a really good way to see the city; especially with beautiful Barcelona weather. Maitane was extremely helpful when our tickets did not show up in the system and she worked with management to get us the access that we purchased.  She went above and beyond.
author: cnmaxie

title: A Nice way of touring Barcelona
text: A very nice way of touring the city. You can buy tickets at numerous outlets either a one or two day bus tour. You can hop on and hop off as much as you like. There are two routes the red bus or the blue bus, which go on separate routes. Your ticket entitles you to both. Buy ahead, very popular.
author: AvidTraveler12

title: Good for seeing the city
text: The bus is clean and accessible. Our audio seemed out of sync with the landmarks, but we still enjoyed seeing the city from the upper deck.
